sn1.5:1.1: The enigmatic repetition of “five” is reminiscent of Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad 4.4.17: “Where the five groups of five and space are established, I regard that Self as the immortal Brahman, knowing which I am immortal.” The redactors show their playful side here, placing this as the fifth sutta of the Saṁyutta.
sn1.5:3.1: According to the commentary, the five lower fetters are cut, the five higher fetters are dropped, and the five faculties are developed.
sn1.5:3.3: The “five chains” are defined at [vb17:238.1]() as greed, hate, delusion, conceit, and views.
